verdict.rationale: Zero is an AI email client, and buyers comparing email and shared-inbox tools can fairly ask about omnichannel support, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents a unified inbox across email providers such as Gmail and Outlook. Nothing shows SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live-chat channels being handled alongside email.

support.subject: As a team-lead, the same inbox also handles adjacent customer channels — SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live chat — beside email
